name: libbsd
description: Library providing useful functions commonly found on BSD systems (queue.h, err.h, arc4random, setproctitle, strlcpy/strlcat, fgetln, and more), easing the portability of software with strong BSD origins to Linux and other non-BSD systems.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
